messages:
anya: Intake — proposing mongoose-3B for onboarding. Workloads: chat assistant + rerank-heavy completions. Requesting prioritization + rollout plan. Early results: ~30% cost reduction vs quokka-6b on int8, latency in same ballpark.

miguel: can you paste the perf numbers (p50/p95) and eval IDs? any sign of hallucination or NLI regression? also quant artifacts?

anya: perf quick dump: p50=85ms @512 tokens, p95=220ms @512 on g5-8; throughput ~120 req/s per GPU. eval bundle: eval/2026-03-mongoose-intake-1 (conversational + rerank suites). int8 baseline ok, int4 smoke looks noisy.

sarah: propose quality gates up-front: stop canary if answer-level BLEU drops >2% OR QA F1 drops >1.5% OR hallucination increase >1%. add an SLO for latency p95 too.

alex: rollout suggestion: hosted canary -> dedicated reserved capacity -> private deploy opt-in. Hosted canary steps: 5% -> 20% -> 50% with 24h observation windows and synthetic traffic @1.5x production.

tariq: fallback strategy: route affected traffic to quokka-6b and capture diffs. auto-rollback triggers: error rate >1% absolute OR latency p95 >350ms OR quality_gate fail.

ci-bot: CI results: quant-int8/job #412 passed all smoke tests; quant-int4/job #410 failed qa_regression. Log snippet: `AssertionError: answer mismatch > threshold` on test qa_contrast_12.

miguel: plan for quant experiments: full int8 sweep across seq lenses [128,512,1024], sampling temp sweep, then targeted int4 for batch offline rerank only if prompt caching works. need per-token perplexity and eval with promptset seed_66.

anya: ops: can we spin up a hosted canary pool for mongoose-3b? want KV pre-warm and a small dedicated pool for 5% routing. Also need a canary config that pins tokenizer + kv-cache behavior.

ops-bot: created pool `mongoose-3b-canary` in us-west-2 (2 x g5.12xlarge). KV pre-warm job scheduled (job id: warm-202603-87).

sarah: observability checklist: add synthetic QPS @1.5x, token-level latency histogram, mismatch rate, prompt-completion drift, and per-route cost breakdown. Alerts to #incidents and #eng-ml on triggers. Capture diffs in S3 path s3://redwood-evals/mongoose3b/diffs/.

alex: rollout CLI snippet for runbook: ```sh
redwood deploy canary --model mongoose-3b:20260325 --pct 5 --monitor 24h
redwood promote --model mongoose-3b:20260325 --to 20 --monitor 24h
```

miguel: who owns the eval dashboard and thresholds? assigning to me — I'll wire eval/2026-03-mongoose-intake-1 into the dashboard and set gate thresholds.

anya: owners & timeline: miguel=quality gating + quant sweeps; sarah=metrics & alerts; alex=runbooks + rollout scripts; tariq=routing rules + rollbacks; ops=infra + pre-warm. Target canary start: Wed 2026-03-25.

tariq: :thumbsup: routing rules I'll add: `if latency.p95 > 350ms then route -> quokka-6b`, `if quality_gate == false then route -> quokka-6b`, and a soft-fallback that gradually reduces pct over 30m. I'll also enable logging of prompt hashes for diff analysis.

anya: noted — also: pre-warm KV with top-500 prompt fingerprints and enable prefix cache during canary. add a smoke test run after deployment: `curl -X POST /v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"<smoke>"}'` against canary endpoint.

ci-bot: smoke-run: canary-smoke passed. artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/mongoose3b/smoke-20260325.tar.gz

sarah: final ask before kickoff: confirm rollback playbook in #eng-oncall and create a 1-hour response window for first two steps.

anya: confirmed. thanks all — will start the canary on Wed and ping when we flip 5%.
